representation.title: Authorisation for ERPlora to file your invoices
representation.loadError: We could not load the authorisation.
representation.forbidden: You do not have permission to see the authorisation

line.none: You have not signed the authorisation yet. Download the official model, sign it and upload it from your business (VeriFactu → Settings).
line.submitted: We are reviewing your authorisation. It usually takes between 24 and 72 hours.
line.approved: Validated on {date}. ERPlora can file your invoices with the AEAT on your behalf.
line.returned: We could not accept the authorisation you sent. Fix what we tell you and upload it again from your business.
line.revoked: The authorisation was withdrawn on {date}. Sign a new one from your business to keep filing through ERPlora.
